issues.summary: Only s8 straight/L architectural normal rooms are formally bundled; original entrance and terminal gameplay are not supported by this minimal pool.
Original unused ports are open. Runtime must close unused apertures and protect the whole reserved envelope without altering immutable source resources or blocking used links.
Coordinate/inverse/actual-aperture tests pass all rotations. Native rotated block states, attachments/neighbor ticks and world walkability require isolated integration validation.

All 72 base-round room NBTs were decoded. Other pools deferred conservatively: exposed or contained liquids still require runtime validation; block entities/entities, falling blocks, dynamic or not-native-verified palette states, even/asymmetric apertures, missing/hash-unbound metadata or source/layout discrepancies prevent immediate admission. See source-audit.json/rejections.json for exact per-source findings; not all exclusions mean source defects.

Assembly layouts may have adapted port heights; original metadata must match original NBT hash. S8-07 original north/south Y2/Y4 differ from layout Y1/Y3 and cannot be substituted. S8-01 has stairs immediately inside north opening; strict rectangular inboard-air MVP excludes it unchanged.
Actual core smoke compiled with --release 17 and executed on installed JDK25.0.2, not a claimed JDK17 execution. Runtime must use its mandated Java17 toolchain.
